card.name: Inside long drug names
card.fires_on: Middle pieces of long brand or generic drug names split into several parts, such as OTARMENI, thiothixene, ustekinumab, LUMAKRAS and LAZCLUZE. It also fires on a few other mid-word spots like myasthenia gravis.

modes.label: Brand names
modes.description: Inner pieces of capitalized brand names written in capitals.
modes.example: do not resume LUM<<AK>>RAS until AST/ALT/bil

modes.label: Generic names
modes.description: Inner pieces of lowercase generic drug names, such as antiretrovirals or monoclonal antibodies.
modes.example: safety of ustek<<in>>umab products in combination with immunos

card.writes: It adds little that is clear; the promoted tokens weakly hint at medication or steroid words and the suppressed tokens look unrelated.
card.plain: It lights up in the middle of long, unfamiliar drug names, before the name is finished.
